{"tool":"python","code":"from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Border, Side

ws1 = wb["Sheet1"]
ws2 = wb["Sheet2"]

calibri = Font(name="Calibri")

# Calibri on Sheet1 A1:B150 and Sheet2 A1:A13
for row in ws1.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=150, min_col=1, max_col=2):
    for c in row:
        c.font = calibri
for row in ws2.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=13, min_col=1, max_col=1):
    for c in row:
        c.font = calibri

# Column A formulas down to A150 (mirror Sheet2, blank when empty)
for r in range(2, 151):
    ws1.cell(row=r, column=1).value = f'=IF(Sheet2!A{r}="","",Sheet2!A{r})'

# B2 formula (harness fills B3:B150 with relative offsets)
ws1["B2"] = '=IFERROR(INDEX($A$2:$A$150,MATCH(0,COUNTIF($B$1:B1,$A$2:$A$150),0)),"")'

# B2:B150 yellow fill + borders (gridlines)
yellow = PatternFill(start_color="FFFF00", end_color="FFFF00", fill_type="solid")
thin = Side(style="thin", color="000000")
border = Border(left=thin, right=thin, top=thin, bottom=thin)
for r in range(2, 151):
    c = ws1.cell(row=r, column=2)
    c.fill = yellow
    c.border = border

# Column A borders only up to row 13
for r in range(1, 14):
    ws1.cell(row=r, column=1).border = border

# Remove gridlines
ws1.sheet_view.showGridLines = False
ws2.sheet_view.showGridLines = False

# Hide Sheet2
ws2.sheet_state = "hidden"

print("B2:", ws1["B2"].value)
print("A2:", ws1["A2"].value)
print("A13:", ws1["A13"].value)
print("A150:", ws1["A150"].value)
print("B150 fill:", ws1["B150"].fill.start_color.rgb)
print("A13 border:", ws1["A13"].border.left.style, "A14 border:", ws1["A14"].border.left.style)
print("Sheet2 state:", ws2.sheet_state)
print("gridlines:", ws1.sheet_view.showGridLines)"}
